Symphonia - Pure Rust media container and audio decoding library
Philip Deljanov and contributors; see upstream source headers for copyright notices.

Upstream source: https://github.com/pdeljanov/Symphonia
Facade dependency: symphonia 0.5.4 (pinned in rust/kg-native-core/Cargo.toml).
Enabled features: ogg, vorbis, flac, wav, pcm, mp3, isomp4, aac.
The upstream codec/container/core/metadata components are resolved by Cargo.
The upstream Rust source is used without modification.

License: Mozilla Public License 2.0 (MPL-2.0).
License text: https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/MPL/2.0/
A copy is included as ThirdParty/Symphonia-MPL-2.0.txt.
Application/native glue code retains the repository's own license.
